_comment: Single source of truth for the Content-Security-Policy meta tag of every
built-in extension viewer. scripts/build-extensions.js synthesizes the real
policy from `baseline` + the extension's `extra` entry and replaces the
Do not hand-edit a built dist/*/index.html: it is overwritten on every build
and a source template that lost its placeholder fails the build on purpose.
`baseline` is applied to all eight extensions; `extra` may only append tokens
to a directive (never replace baseline tokens). Directives are emitted in
baseline order, with any extra-only directive appended at the end.
`header` is the same policy as a real HTTP response header (see the
`whale-extension://` handler). A meta-delivered policy cannot enforce
frame-ancestors, so the header replaces that directive with `frameAncestors`:
`'self'` keeps draw.io's same-origin inner iframe working, and the app-shell
origin is substituted for `appOriginPlaceholder` at runtime (`file:` in
production, the dev-server origin in development). Because Chromium logs
an error for every meta-delivered frame-ancestors, the meta injection strips
that directive entirely (`META_OMITTED_DIRECTIVES` in the build script); it
is delivered only by the header.
